title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Timothy H. Edgar is a leading expert on cybersecurity and privacy, with over two decades of experience as a scholar, national security official, and privacy and civil liberties lawyer. Timothy is a professor of the practice of computer science at Brown University, a senior fellow at the Watson School of International and Public Affairs, and […]
